items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: I had a transcribing job of all of Booker Little’s stuff for a publisher

ctx.x: And I think it’s an interesting endeavor and I wondered if you started out with a quill — you know the special pens and the paper and then at some point did you transition to Finale or Sibelius?

Yeah. I’ve learned so much. I have hundreds of composers’ music on my computer. I’ve learnt so much from copying music it’s not funny. I did start doing it [air quotes] professionally — well let me back up. Me and Nicki took exams every year, there’s a system in Australia, part of the classical music system, Australian Music Examination Board, so you could take like classical piano, classical whatever exams, but you also, every year we would take musicianship exams and a theory exam. They were separate. So in…
